mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is derived from the change in FEDFUNDS over the prior 3 months, and the signal is always active (no threshold condition).
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with a 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 280, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative. The signal is the current CPI value crossing above 280.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL > 280 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) has increased by more than 0.3% over the past 3 months, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are positive. The signal is the joint condition of low unemployment and rising industrial production.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, a positive 3-month change in GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the change in GDP, active only in high-unemployment regimes.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE>4.5% and GDP (GDPC1) has a positive 3-month change are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive 1-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is the change in INDPRO from the previous month, and the signal is always active (no threshold condition).
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods with a positive 1-month change in INDPRO are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1700, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positive. The signal is the current housing starts value crossing above 1700.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods when HOUST > 1700 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is the change in CPIAUCSL over the prior 3 months, and the signal is always active (no threshold condition).
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods with a 3-month decline in CPIAUCSL are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive 1-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is the change in PAYEMS from the previous month, and the signal is always active (no threshold condition).
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods with a positive 1-month change in PAYEMS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
